result:
Core shell and reports are now built against `billingUrl = https://homelab.local/billing/v2`, and the change is live. PR #3 (`plat-104-3-4-shell-reports-adopt-v2`) covers both and merged with CI and CD green. I only checked the new address in my local builds, not on the CDN.

- **What changed:** I patch-bumped `apps/core-shell` and `apps/sub-route-reports` from 1.0.0 to 1.0.1. `libs/shared-contracts` lives in this repo and is inlined at build time, so there was no dependency to update. The bump exists because CD only rebuilds an app when files under its own directory change. My local builds of both apps contain `billing/v2`.
- **Coordination:** I polled the board until dev-a's PR #1 (the `billingUrl` change) merged. Then I pulled `main`, built, opened PR #3 and marked tasks 3 and 4 done. I used one PR for both tasks since they have no ordering between them.
- **Billing app:** dev-a's PR #2 for that was still open when I finished. I didn't touch it.
- **Surprises:** `docs/releasing.md` says `libs/shared-contracts` isn't part of CD change detection, so a lib change alone deploys nothing. That is why the version bump was needed.
